rationale: Calculated three-phase and two-phase short-circuit currents at each specified fault location by summing source, transformer, and feeder impedances. The maximum three-phase current (9.307 kA) and minimum two-phase current (1.508 kA) were identified. The breaker rating (12.5 kA) was selected as the smallest standard rating exceeding the maximum fault current multiplied by the safety factor (1.1). The relay pickup (602.075 A) was chosen to be within the required range, above the load margin (1.25 * max_load) and below the minimum fault sensitivity limit (min_2ph_fault / 2.0).
